metadata.name: LinuxToys
metadata.summary: Software distribution and system configuration platform for multiple Linux distributions

content.value: LinuxToys is a software distribution platform and system configuration utility designed to make powerful Linux functionality simple and accessible through an intuitive graphical interface. It provides users and developers with a unified solution to manage, tweak, and reliably deploy software across dozens of Linux environments.

By standardizing application installation workflows and environment setups, LinuxToys bridges differences across packaging ecosystems, from traditional desktop distributions to immutable atomic systems.

items.value: Unified software installation and management across diverse Linux distributions
Broad compatibility covering Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch Linux, openSUSE, and derivatives
Support for immutable atomic distributions including Atomic Fedora and Universal Blue images
Handheld and gaming system compatibility including SteamOS and AppImage deployment
Intuitive desktop interface offering performance tweaks and system optimization tools
